The Jets are the fourth team in the Graveyard after the Bills beat them 31-12 and dropped them to 2-8. The Chargers won in Baltimore on Monday night but stay down there at 1-8, because the playoff floor doesn't step up again until game 12. Three teams are right on the line next week: the Eagles at 2-7 host the Steelers, and the Colts and Cardinals at 3-7 go to Houston and Kansas City, so one loss sends any of them down. And the Patriots got blown out in Detroit to fall to 5-5, exactly where the 2001 Patriots sat after ten games on their way to a title.
